notes.title: Patch Notes - Weapon Balancing & Upgrade System Update
notes.notes:
Weapon Adjustments:

Assault Rifle: Increased accuracy and reduced recoil to improve mid-range combat effectiveness.


Sniper Rifle: Slightly reduced fire rate to balance long-range engagements.

Pistol: Increased magazine size and reduced reload time to improve usability.

Submachine Gun (SMG): Adjusted damage scaling for better performance at close range.

New Feature - Weapon Upgrade Bench:
A brand-new Weapon Upgrade Bench is now available, allowing players to enhance their weapons through multiple evolution stages. Players can find the bench in various locations and upgrade weapons using collected resources.

Weapon Evolution System:

Tier 1 (Basic): Default stats with no modifications.

Tier 2 (MK 1): Slightly increased damage and improved accuracy.


Bug Fixes:


Resolved a bug causing the sniper rifle’s aim assist to behave erratically.

Addressed an exploit where players could reload instantly by swapping weapons rapidly.

Fixed a UI glitch causing incorrect ammo counts to display in certain situations.

General stability and performance improvements to enhance gameplay experience.

notes.title: Patch 1.6 Coming soon
notes.notes: Due to a new first-person horror project we are starting, we have delayed updates for 2 months. Therefore, the next update will come out in March, specifically on the 20th. We will implement a new map and replace it with the NeonCity map, since we are changing maps seasonally to make the gameplay more dynamic and not repetitive. On the other hand, we will add new missions that can be completed by doing a series of challenges to escape the map. The March update will be on the 20th starting at 8:00 CET.

notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.notes:
- The switch and fuses have been changed for new models
- Now the switch tells you if it needs fuses or not
- Doors have been added to all maps to finish the map (once that door is opened you complete the map).
- The error that at the beginning of the game a red stripe appeared for 2 seconds has been corrected
- The advantage system has been modified and new lighting and text that specifies what advantage it is have now been added to the machines.

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
- New map implemented in the game: Infinite Room
• It is a small room that you will have to survive infinite rounds. Until what rounds will you survive?
• Collect as many souls as possible in the soul chest on the map. Although yes, it will be impossible.

- New implementation in electricity: Fuse
• Gather one or more fuses and place them in the fuse machine to activate the electricity
• Fuses are currently in beta mode so they are only available in the fourth and new map Infinite Room.

- Correction in the texts of the advantages
- UI fix when getting a new perk
- Some of the biggest updates are coming so we will have another new map even bigger than the first, so there will be. challenges for it and new implementations in the characters with a new weapon.

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
- We have implemented a new mechanic: Electricity

‧ Interact with the switch to activate or deactivate the power (default is disabled)
‧ Now the advantages are deactivated and cannot be purchased unless you turn on the electricity (a warning will appear with a light that illuminates if it is activated).
‧ Soon we will add doors and fuses to activate them with electricity (more information soon).

- We have changed the purchase of weapons to a more realistic arsenal of weapons and with lighting so that you can clearly see the weapons where you can buy.

- We have changed the textures of Floor 52 as they looked a bit repetitive.

- We have fixed a bug with the achievement list in the first map, so it can now be obtained by completing the map.

- We have corrected texts that appeared errors in the interface.

- We are in development with the following map with new implementations on the map so the development can take a long time, we appreciate the support and wait for this project. Possibly I know we will delate the second map The Floor and replace the next map so you can play it in a limited way at the moment.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
- New 9 random animations on zombies have been implemented.
- The "how to play" section has been modified and we have briefly explained the important points to complete the maps.
- The sounds have been modified and we have made them 20% less noisy (the sound can be modified in the settings section).
- Fixed synchronization problems with servers when creating the server host in multiplayer mode.
- The power of all weapons has been increased by 10% (except the main pistol, G18).

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
- The RA-3000 weapon damage has been increased by 5%
- Decreased the probability of zombies spawning in close range.
- Bugs related to the game interface have been fixed.
